description: Sequential ensemble of shallow decision trees. Each new tree fits the negative gradient (residuals) of the previous ensemble, scaled by a learning rate. Histogram-based binning makes it scalable. sklearn's HistGradientBoostingClassifier is used (not AdaBoost or a separate boosting library).
why_tested: End-semester addition; tests whether sequentially correcting prior errors improves over bagging and linear baselines.
input_features: Dense TruncatedSVD (100 components, training-fold fitted) of word unigram/bigram TF-IDF.
selection_rule: Max mean macro F1 on fixed group-respecting CV folds (development data only)
artifact_note: Fitted development pipeline saved to models/gradient_boosting/artifacts/{protocol}/ (model.joblib + svd.joblib + metadata.json). The implementation is sklearn's HistGradientBoostingClassifier; no separate boosting library is added.
